title: Bill splitting app
summary: Split bills and track who owes what among friends and housemates.
whyTempting: Everyone has awkward money moments with friends.
whyItFails: Feature, not company. Payment apps and banks add splitting. Hard to monetise. Users won't pay to split $40. Low frequency for most. Heavy users are a small niche.
whatWouldChange: Embedded in a payment rail that earns on the transaction.

attempts.outcome: Sold by Obopay to rival BillPin
attempts.notes: Purchased by mobile payments company Obopay in January 2007, integrating SMS expense entry and mobile/online payments.

attempts.outcome: Acquired by Braintree, now part of PayPal
attempts.notes: Bought by Braintree in 2012 for $26.2 million; PayPal acquired Braintree in 2013.

reasons.detail: Feature, not company: Payment apps and banks add splitting.
Hard to monetise: Users won't pay to split $40.
Low frequency for most: Heavy users are a small niche.
